record.field:
Digital Data Farm (DDF) · Odoo Integration

Official API base URL: https://apy.digitaldatafarm.com

1) Connection

Type: REST

Authentication handled via API key configured in the Remote Control record.

connection_params example:

{
  "api_key": "your_api_key_here"
}

Authentication is done via header: Authorization: API-KEY <api_key>

2) Available Procedures

A) DDF: Get Plots (One-time setup)

Discovers all available plots and their dataloggers/channels:

  1. Calls GET /plots/ → retrieves all plots
  2. For each plot: GET /plots/{plot_id} → gets datalogger IDs and location description
  3. For each datalogger: GET /dataloggers/{mp_id}/ → gets measurement point details and channels
  4. Generates JSON attachment: ddf_plots_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json grouped by location

Use this JSON file to identify the correct datalogger_id and sensor_id values for your devices/sensors.

B) DDF: Daily Sync (Scheduled)

Synchronizes readings from configured devices/sensors:

  1. Get devices (plan) - Builds execution plan from sensors with remotecontrol_params
  2. Get readings - Downloads readings from DDF API and upserts into Odoo

3) Device & Sensor Configuration

Uses standard Odoo models:

  • Device: mdm.measurement.device
  • Sensor: mdm.measurement.device.sensor

Device remotecontrol_params (optional):

{
  "start_date": "2026-01-01"
}
  • start_date: Default start date if sensor has no readings yet (fallback to current year start)

Sensor remotecontrol_params (required):

{
  "datalogger_id": 1108,
  "sensor_id": 23695
}

Parameters:

  • datalogger_id: DDF mp_id (measurement point ID). Get from "DDF: Get Plots" output
  • sensor_id: DDF dc_id (device channel ID). Get from "DDF: Get Plots" output

4) API Endpoints Used

  • GET /plots/ → List all plots (with trailing slash)
  • GET /plots/{plot_id} → Get plot details + datalogger IDs (no trailing slash)
  • GET /dataloggers/{mp_id}/ → Get datalogger details + channels (with trailing slash)
  • GET /dataloggers/{mp_id}/device_channel/{dc_id}/data?start_date={iso}&end_date={iso} → Get readings

⚠️ Important: Trailing slashes matter! Server returns 307 redirects without proper slashes.

5) Date Window for Fetching Data

The fetch window is computed per sensor:

  1. If sensor has readings: start from last reading date (no +1 day to avoid gaps)
  2. If start_date configured: use that date
  3. Otherwise: 01/01/{current_year}

To date: {today}

API limitation: Maximum 1-month range per request. Larger ranges are automatically split into 30-day chunks.

6) Data Conversion

  • Timestamps: Unix seconds (UTC) → YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (stored as UTC in Odoo)
  • Values: Converted to float
  • Date format: ISO 8601 with milliseconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ

7) Database Upsert Logic

Each reading is upserted into:

mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading

Unique key:

{
  "sensor_id": SENSOR_ID,
  "measurement_time": TIMESTAMP
}

Stored values:

  • value

8) API Response Structures

GET /plots/

{
  "plots": [
    {
      "plot_id": 123,
      "plot_name": "Lechugas 1",
      "descr": "Parcela lechugas 1",
      "loc": [-2.557, 36.0001],
      "report_name": "DDF3",
      "crop_name": "Lechuga",
      "active": true
    }
  ]
}

GET /plots/{plot_id}

{
  "plot": {
    "plot_id": 123,
    "res_id": 45,
    "loc_descr": "Totana"
  },
  "dataloggers": [1234, 5678]
}

GET /dataloggers/{mp_id}/

{
  "measurement_point": {
    "mp_id": 1234,
    "mp_name": "PM12341",
    "descr": "Description",
    "plot_id": 123,
    "mp_loc": [-2.557, 36.0001],
    "active": true
  },
  "channels": [
    {
      "dc_id": 10255,
      "dev_ch_idtext": "H12341_10CM",
      "variable": "Agua en el suelo",
      "unit": "%",
      "depth": 10.0,
      "model": "Sonda 6 profundidades"
    }
  ]
}

GET /dataloggers/{mp_id}/device_channel/{dc_id}/data

{
  "channel_data": [
    [1762381800, 10.5],
    [1762380000, 11.2]
  ]
}

Each entry: [unix_timestamp_seconds, value]

9) Error Handling

  • Missing datalogger_id or sensor_id → sensor skipped
  • HTTP 307 redirect → caught and logged (check trailing slashes)
  • HTTP 4xx/5xx error → logged and counted in audit JSON
  • Invalid timestamp/value → reading skipped

10) Execution Sequence

Daily Sync procedure:

  1. Get devices (plan) (sequence 10)
  2. Get readings (sequence 20)

An audit JSON file is attached to the remote control record after each sync with statistics.

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
remote = self.remote_id cfg = {} try: cfg = json.loads(remote.connection_params or '{}') except Exception: cfg = {} api_key = (cfg.get('api_key') or '').strip() if not api_key: raise Exception("Missing DDF api_key in connection_params.") headers = {'Authorization': 'API-KEY %s' % api_key} base = (base_url or '').rstrip('/')
sensors_plan = bag.get('sensors_plan') or [] if not sensors_plan: raise Exception("No sensors_plan found in bag. Run Get Devices (plan) first.")
today = fields.Date.today() total_upserts = 0 total_errors = 0 items = []
for plan_item in sensors_plan: sensor_id = plan_item.get('sensor_id') datalogger_id = plan_item.get('datalogger_id') sensor_id_param = plan_item.get('sensor_id_param') initial_date = plan_item.get('initial_date')
if not (sensor_id and datalogger_id and sensor_id_param and initial_date): continue
upserts = 0 errs = 0 urls_called = []
try: current_dt = datetime.strptime(initial_date, '%Y-%m-%d') except Exception: continue end_dt = datetime.strptime(today, '%Y-%m-%d')
while current_dt <= end_dt: chunk_end = min(current_dt + timedelta(days=30), end_dt) start_str = current_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') end_str = chunk_end.strftime('%Y-%m-%d') start_iso = '%sT00:00:00.000Z' % start_str end_iso = '%sT00:00:00.000Z' % end_str url = '%s/dataloggers/%s/device_channel/%s/data?start_date=%s&end_date=%s' % ( base, datalogger_id, sensor_id_param, start_iso, end_iso) urls_called.append(url)
try: resp = request_retry('GET', url, headers=headers, timeout=timeout) if resp.status_code >= 400: errs += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'datalogger_id': datalogger_id, 'sensor_id_param': sensor_id_param, 'url': url, 'status': resp.status_code, 'error': (resp.text or '')[:400], }) else: channel_data = (resp.json() or {}).get('channel_data') or [] for entry in channel_data: try: unix_ts = entry[0] value = float(entry[1]) utc_dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(unix_ts, tz=pytz.UTC) ts_str = utc_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') remote.upsert( 'mdm.measurement.device.sensor.reading', {'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'measurement_time': ts_str}, {'value': value}, ) upserts += 1 except Exception: errs += 1 except Exception as e: errs += 1 items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'datalogger_id': datalogger_id, 'sensor_id_param': sensor_id_param, 'url': url, 'status': -1, 'error': str(e), })
current_dt = chunk_end + timedelta(days=1)
total_upserts += upserts total_errors += errs items.append({ 'sensor_id': sensor_id, 'datalogger_id': datalogger_id, 'sensor_id_param': sensor_id_param, 'upserts': upserts, 'errors': errs, 'urls': urls_called, })
audit = { 'executed_at': fields.Datetime.now(), 'total_upserts': total_upserts, 'total_errors': total_errors, 'items': items, } b64 = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(audit, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2).encode('utf-8')) fname = 'ddf_readings_%s.json' % fields.Datetime.now().replace(':', '').replace('-', '').replace(' ', '_') att = env['ir.attachment'].create({ 'name': fname, 'datas_fname': fname, 'datas': b64, 'mimetype': 'application/json', 'res_model': 'remotecontrol', 'res_id': remote.id, }) remote.message_post( body=u'[DDF] upserts=%s errors=%s' % (total_upserts, total_errors), attachment_ids=[att.id] ) bag['upserts'] = total_upserts bag['errors'] = total_errors bag['audit_attachment_id'] = att.id
